entries.subject: topic:jallikattu_ban_and_protests
entries.value_text: Animal rights organisations called for a ban on jallikattu, resulting in the Supreme Court of India banning it several times, and protests from the people against the ban led to a new ordinance in 2017.

sources.title: Jallikattu
sources.excerpt: Because of incidents of injury and death associated with the sport, both to the participants and to the animals forced into it, animal rights organizations have called for a ban on the sport, resulting in the Supreme Court of India banning it several times over the past years. However, with protests from the people against the ban, a new ordinance was enacted in 2017 to continue the sport.

entries.value_text: In the Kaveri water dispute, Tamil Nadu argued that about 3 million acres under cultivation depend heavily on the river water and that any change to the sharing pattern would adversely affect millions of farmers.
